nodes.description: At the left-right organizer (the mouse node, Xenopus gastrocoel roof plate and zebrafish Kupffer's vesicle) DAND5 and Nodal are co-expressed in the marginal crown cells. Leftward flow, sensed through the PKD2 channel, triggers Bicc1- and Ccr4-Not-dependent decay of Dand5 mRNA on the left, so Nodal is released on the left only. DAND5 is the first gene to be asymmetrically expressed and the main target of flow. When it is absent, Nodal at the organizer is active on both sides and the flow signal has nothing to act on, so the left-right cue passed to the lateral plate is lost or randomized. The ciliary machinery that produces the flow is not affected.
